name: encrypted-value-unknown-entity-tolerated
description: a REASONING_ENCRYPTED_VALUE whose entityId names nothing the consumer knows cannot be stored where it belongs, and MUST NOT fail the run — the rest of the conversation survives it intact
kill: make an unresolvable entityId on REASONING_ENCRYPTED_VALUE throw, or attach the artefact to some other message, instead of leaving it unstored

dotnet.intentional: The tolerance the fixture requires holds — the run completes and the conversation survives — but .NET materialises the encrypted value as its own reasoning-content update keyed on the entityId, so an unknown entity leaves an extra contentless message behind instead of being stored nowhere.
